summary: Grupo Supervielle S.A. filed a Form 6-K to disclose board approval of related-party transactions between the company and its wholly owned subsidiary, Supervielle Agente de Negociación S.A.U., under Argentine Capital Markets Law. The transactions rebalance the investment portfolio at market prices and terms with no material impact on consolidated financial condition. The Audit Committee issued a favorable prior opinion. No acquisition, divestiture, or special-situation event occurred; this is a routine related-party disclosure with no structural deal terms, premium, or regulatory clock.
